articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Fans faced a bit of sticker shock today when Nintendo revealed the Switch 2 would cost $450, especially with some new physical games set to cost as much as $90. But the price of upgrading to the Mario maker’s next console generation is set to get even worse after President Donald Trump announced a new wave of shockingl…

articles.title: Trump Shocks With Massive New Tariffs That Could Make The Switch 2 Cost More Than $600

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
Today, during Nintendo’s big Switch 2 Direct, we got a bunch of trailers for upcoming games and finally learned that the new console will be launching June 5. But the real star of the show wasn’t a new Donkey Kong game or voice chat, it was a simple yet badass cow on a scooter built out of a boombox. 
Read more...
articles.title: Mario Kart World's Breakout Star Is This Awesome Cow

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
A Minecraft Movie comes out this weekend and early reviews are all over the place. Some are calling the gaming adaptation starring Jack Black and Jason Momoa a nonsensical disaster, while others think it’s not actually that bad. Microsoft’s Hollywood debut might feel like naked IP exploitation but it’s not necessarily…
Read more...
articles.title: A Minecraft Movie Sounds Like A Mess That Might Not Be Terrible

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Nintendo has officially revealed Mario Kart 9 and it’s actually called Mario Kart World. Players will race across new courses staged all over the world and in a series first be able to drive all around the map in-between races. The game will feature 24 players per match and include new racers like Paulina and new…
Read more...
articles.title: Mario Kart World Is An Open-World Switch 2 Launch Game

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
On Wednesday, Nintendo held a big Direct dedicated to the upcoming Switch 2. The new console is set to launch on June 5 and will cost $450. And one of the launch games for the console is Mario Kart World, a big, sprawling kart racer that looks like a lot of fun. But uh, what the heck is Mario drinking in that can?
Read more...
articles.title: So What The Hell Is Mario Drinking In Mario Kart World?

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Battery life for gaming handhelds is always a challenge but the tradeoffs for the Switch 2 appear to be particularly brutal. Nintendo has confirmed that the next-gen device will run for anywhere from 2-6.5 hours on a single charge depending on what you’re playing. It ain’t great. In fact, it’s somehow even worse than…
Read more...
articles.title: The Switch 2's Battery Life Is Worse Than The Original

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
The Nintendo Switch 2 launches on June 5 and at least one major retailer is bringing back an old-school midnight launch to help fans celebrate early. Best Buy will be opening stores at 12:01 a.m. ET for anyone who pre-ordered the console and launch games like Mario Kart World. 
Read more...
articles.title: Midnight Console Launches Are Making A Comeback For The Switch 2

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
On April 2, Nintendo pulled back the curtain and revealed all about the Switch 2. The upcoming console is set to launch on June 5 and will cost $450. So what will be available to play on your fancy new Switch 2 later this year? We have a list that should prove useful! 
Read more...
articles.title: Every Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Game

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
Following today’s hour-long Nintendo Switch 2 Direct, the company has continued to post new information about the console and its upcoming games. This post-Direct news feed included a series of interviews with the people behind the creation of the $450 console—launching in June—and from those, we learned that the…
Read more...
articles.title: The Switch 2 Was Almost Called The Super Switch

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
A Nintendo Switch 2 will set you back $450. Mario Kart World will be $90 for the physical version. There’s a tutorial for the new hardware and its features complete with demos and minigames called  Switch 2 Welcome Tour. It will also cost money. Nintendo is preparing to launch its most anticipated console ever and…
Read more...
articles.title: The Internet Reacts To Switch 2 And Mario Kart Sticker Price Shock

articles.author: John Walker
articles.description:
Back in January, I lamented the idea that the Switch 2 would simply be an upgraded Switch. Not because I wouldn’t buy one—I’d be there day one regardless—but because what I’ve loved about Nintendo for so many decades is the company’s desire to just be strange. From the clamshell two-screen bizarreness of the DS to the…
Read more...
articles.title: The Switch 2's Camera Is The Weird New Nintendo Idea I Was Hoping For

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
Today, Nintendo revealed all about the Switch 2. The new console is set to launch in June and will cost $450. And it will, as previously announced, support most OG Switch games. However, two new compatibility lists from Nintendo seem to indicate that over 100 Switch games will have various issues or just flat-out not…
Read more...
articles.title: Over 120 Switch Games Have Compatibility Issues Or Won't Start Up At All On Switch 2

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Imprisoning War is a key part of the backstory for The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom and it will be playable in the next Hyrule Warriors. The latest Zelda musou spin-off will lets fans take control of the Hyrulian princess, Zonai King Rauru, and other sages as they try to lock away the Demon King Ganon…
Read more...
articles.title: New Hyrule Warriors Will Take Fans Inside Zelda: Tears Of The Kingdom's Imprisoning War

articles.author: Kenneth Shepard
articles.description:
Console pre-orders are a notoriously painful process. If you’re trying to get them online, scalpers and bots are likely to snatch them up at stores like Target or Best Buy. With the Switch 2 coming in hot, Nintendo is putting some restrictions in place on its online store to hopefully make sure people who actually…
Read more...
articles.title: Switch 2 Pre-Order Rules Are Some BS: Here's How They Work

articles.author: Claire Jackson
articles.description:
Today was the day Nintendo finally shared with us a much-needed deep dive on the highly anticipated successor to its wildly successful hybrid console, the Switch. The Switch 2 was proudly shown off by the company during a Direct and at long last we got a look at some upcoming games, what makes this machine unique from…
Read more...
articles.title: Everything We Saw At The Big Switch 2 Reveal

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Donkey Kong has been pulled up to the majors. The 2D platforming star is back in a 3D adventure for the first time since the absolutely terrible Donkey Kong 64. Fortunately, things look way better in Donkey Kong Bananza for the Switch 2.
Read more...
articles.title: New 3D Donkey Kong Adventure Could Be Switch 2's Mario Odyssey

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
The biggest game of 2022 is going to be one of the biggest games on Switch 2 in 2025. Nintendo revealed Elden Ring, FromSoftware’s hit open world RPG, is coming to the new console with a Tarnished Edition that includes not just the Erdtree expansion but also “new weapons, armor, a new Torrent appearance customization,…
Read more...
articles.title: Arise Now, Ye Tarnished: Switch 2 Is Getting Elden Ring

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
During today’s big Nintendo Switch 2 Direct, the company revealed a ton of new games, confirmed the console will launch in June, and showed off Mario Kart World, a new open-world racing exclusive for the Switch 2 that will cost $80. Yes. you read that price correctly.
Read more...
articles.title: Mario Kart World On Switch 2 Will Cost $80

articles.author: Kenneth Shepard
articles.description:
If you were watching Nintendo’s big Switch 2 Direct live this morning, you might have noticed that things got a little wonky midway through. At first, the video and audio seemed to be out of sync, with presenters like Gearbox boss Randy Pitchford’s mouth not aligning with his words. Then it got progressively worse, as…
Read more...
articles.title: It Wasn't Just You, Nintendo's Big Switch 2 Stream Was Completely Messed Up For A Minute

articles.author: Kenneth Shepard
articles.description:
One of the biggest announcements during Nintendo’s Switch 2 Direct wasn’t a Nintendo game or major feature reveal for the system. Instead, it was from Elden Ring developer FromSoftware, who closed out the showcase’s partner segment by revealing The Duskbloods, a new Soulslike from the team that will be exclusive to…
Read more...
articles.title: FromSoftware's Next Game Is A Switch 2 Exclusive

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
During today’s big Switch 2 Direct, Nintendo announced that GameCube games will be playable on the upcoming hybrid console when it launches in June. You’ll need a Switch Online membership to access the new classic games. 
Read more...
articles.title: Switch 2 Online Gets GameCube Games Including Zelda: Wind Waker

articles.author: Kenneth Shepard
articles.description:
We’re about 30 minutes into Nintendo’s hour-long Switch 2 Direct, and one of the big announcements the company made is that some old Switch games are getting “Switch 2 Editions” that will have improved performance on the beefier system. However, while some games like The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Tears…
Read more...
articles.title: Metroid Prime 4 And Pokémon Legends: Z-A Will Be Cross-Gen On Switch 2

articles.author: John Walker
articles.description:
It’s happening! It’s official! We now finally know nearly everything important about the Switch 2. In today’s Switch 2 Direct, Nintendo broke down details of what the console will offer, what specs it offers, and when it’ll be available to buy.
Read more...
articles.title: The Switch 2 Launches June 5, Costs $450: Here's Everything You Need To Know

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
Today, during Nintendo’s big Switch 2 Direct we learned that The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and it’s even bigger sequel, The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, will be some of first Switch games to get a Switch 2 Edition paid upgrade, allowing for improved visuals and other cool features. 
Read more...
articles.title: Zelda: Breath Of The Wild 1 & 2 Are Getting Switch 2 Upgrades

articles.author: Kenneth Shepard
articles.description:
Happy Switch 2 Day everyone. Nintendo is holding its Switch 2 Direct showcase right now, and one of the first big reveals the company announced has cleared up the mystery of the console’s new “C” button on the right Joy-Con. It stands for “Chat.” Nintendo is finally bringing native voice chat to one of its consoles.
Read more...
articles.title: We Now Know What The Switch 2's Mysterious C Button Does

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Clip your overalls, put on your caps, and strap in: Nintendo’s big Switch 2 reveal is finally upon us. Below you can find out how to watch the Switch 2 Direct and everything else you should know about Nintendo’s plans for the new console this week. 
Read more...
articles.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Direct And Beyond: Everything To Know For This Weeks Ongoing Reveals

articles.author: Kenneth Shepard
articles.description:
Most video game companies use April Fools’ Day to make a social media post about something improbable, like a dating sim spin-off or a product they will never actually put out. Overwatch 2 goes the extra mile and releases an entire game mode that cranks every one of its heroes up to their most chaotic form. The annual…
Read more...
articles.title: Overwatch 2’s Amazing Annual April Fools’ Day Mode Is Just As Incredible This Year

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
The world of John Wick is expanding in a bunch of different directions. Lionsgate announced plans for three new movies, including John Wick 5 which will once again star Keanu Reeves and be directed by franchise director Chad Stahelski. 
Read more...
articles.title: Keanu Reeves Returning For John Wick 5 And An Animated Prequel Movie

articles.author: Brandon Morgan
articles.description:
As an RPG with tons of lore and world-building, you should expect to find plenty of unique weapons, items, and armor sets that buff your abilities tenfold in Avowed. One such unique is Delver’s Caution, a powerful ring that grants additional Dexterity and increases your movement capabilities, making you a parkour…
Read more...
articles.title: This Unique Ring In Avowed Turns You Into A Parkour Legend

articles.author: Simon Estey
articles.description:
The first of Zoe’s worlds in Split Fiction will task you and a partner with saving her fantasy land from the evil Ice King. The guide will tell you exactly how to take down this fearsome (and occasionally cute) monster.
Read more...
articles.title: Here's How To Take Down The Ice King, Split Fiction's Adorable Behemoth

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Are you ready for your games to get buggier? Over 300 quality assurance testers working on Bethesda franchises like Fallout and The Elder Scrolls have voted to authorize a strike following what they say are stalling negotiations with parent company Microsoft. “We’ve had to continuously fight for what should be bare…
Read more...
articles.title: Bethesda Devs Threaten Strike As Union Negotiations Drag On At Microsoft

articles.author: Billy Givens
articles.description:
If you’re a diehard fan of the soulslike genre, you likely want each game you dive into to be lengthy and filled with things to keep you busy. Luckily, The First Berserker: Khazan provides exactly that—a long and challenging campaign, significant amounts of gear grinding and tinkering, and tons of optional levels and…
Read more...
articles.title: The First Berserker: Khazan's Runtime Doesn't Disappoint

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Baldur’s Village is a fan expansion that adds the characters from Dungeons & Dragons RPG Baldur’s Gate 3 to the cozy, pixel art farming sim Stardew Valley. The head of Larian Studios, which made Baldur’s Gate 3, thought it was really cool. But Wizards of the Coast, who owns the D&D license? Not so much. The tabletop…
Read more...
articles.title: Baldur's Gate 3-Themed Stardew Valley Mod Hit With Takedown By D&D Owner [Update: It's Back]

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
Nintendo has posted a new short teaser video focused entirely on the Switch 2's mysterious C button. This seems to confirm that Nintendo knows that since officially revealing the console in January, we all can’t stop theorizing what the button does. We’re hoping to finally know via the upcoming console’s April 2…
Read more...
articles.title: New Switch 2 Teaser Confirms Nintendo Knows You All Can't Stop Thinking About The C Button

articles.author: Billy Givens
articles.description:
PowerWash Simulator can provide endless hours of relaxation, especially if you’re prone to enjoy watching things go from dirty to clean. While you’ll spend your time spraying dirt and grime away without many extra things to consider, some stages have special one-off objectives you can do to earn trophies or…
Read more...
articles.title: Where The Heck Did Patrick Leave His ID Card In PowerWash Simulator?

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
Early in-development screenshots of a previously announced Star Wars game from Electronic Arts, Respawn, and Bit Reactor have leaked online. And while the screens are from an older build of the game, it seems like this upcoming Star Wars game is heavily inspired by XCOM. 
Read more...
articles.title: Upcoming Star Wars Game Leaks, Looks A Lot Like XCOM

articles.author: Kenneth Shepard
articles.description:
It’s wild to think that Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse was at one point supposed to have come out over a year ago, but we’re only now, in 2025, getting our first look at the animated sequel. The third Spider-Verse film has had reported development challenges that have pushed it from its projected 2024 release…
Read more...
articles.title: We Finally Have Our First Look At Beyond The Spider-Verse

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Former Donkey Kong champion Billy Mitchell won his defamation lawsuit against speedrunning YouTuber Karl Jobst in Australia on Monday, over claims published in videos that blamed Mitchell for the death of another YouTuber. Jobst had also accused Mitchell of being aggressively litigious in trying to shut down…
Read more...
articles.title: Former Donkey Kong Champion Billy Mitchell Wins $275,000 For Defamation Over YouTuber's Death

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
If you look at the the top played games on Steam, you might notice something new right at the top. Above the usual  heavy hitters and longtime classics you’ll spot Schedule I, an open-world, first-person drug-dealing sim developed by one guy that, as I write this, has over 340,000 concurrent players on Steam. 
Read more...
articles.title: One Of The Year's Biggest Games Is An Indie Drug-Dealing Sim Made By A Solo Dev

articles.author: Ethan Gach, Zack Zwiezen, Kenneth Shepard, and John Walker
articles.description:
We’re less than 48 hours away from the Switch 2 deep-dive everyone’s been waiting months for, and the biggest questions around power, price, release timing, and launch lineup still remain. Will Nintendo play it safe as it seems to have done so far with the new hardware, or has it been patiently keeping a big surprise…
Read more...
articles.title: Our Hopes And Predictions For The Switch 2 Nintendo Direct

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
483 days ago, Rockstar Games released the first trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6. And assuming GTA 6 doesn’t get delayed, the CEO of Rockstar parent company Take-Two seems to have indicated that fans might have to wait a few more months yet before another GTA 6 trailer arrives. 
Read more...
articles.title: GTA 6's Second Trailer Will Likely Arrive Closer To Launch, Says Take-Two CEO

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
Monster Hunter Wilds is rounding out its one-month anniversary with a major patch later this week. It’ll add new features and monsters to the game, as well as some urgent stability improvements on PC where performance has remained pretty abysmal since launch. 
Read more...
articles.title: Monster Hunter Wilds' First Major Update Promises Much-Needed Performance Improvements On PC

articles.author: Brandon Morgan
articles.description:
I used to be the sentimental type in video games. For instance, if a certain character offered you a weapon—a keepsake—I would hang on to that weapon for as long as possible. Something like Naoe’s starting katana would be the kind of thing that I’d stubbornly hold onto for far too long. 
Read more...
articles.title: Make Sure To Snag These Legendary Weapons In Assassin's Creed Shadows

articles.author: Brian Barnett
articles.description:
Cloak & Dagger are one of the most commonly picked Strategist characters in the entire game, and for good reason: They are incredibly powerful. While each of their abilities are somewhat limited, you’ll maintain control of two characters with completely different roles, so balancing them will be key to excelling.
Read more...
articles.title: Master The Powers Of Shadow And Light With Marvel Rivals' Cloak & Dagger

articles.author: Zack Zwiezen
articles.description:
Some oddly-shaped baseball bats have become a hot topic among fans and players, after the Yankees’ so-called “Torpedo Bats” seemingly helped some sluggers hit multiple home runs. 
Read more...
articles.title: Torpedo Bats Aren't Technically Cheating, But Still Causing Controversy In The MLB

articles.description:
While you and a partner are exploring the worlds created by Split Fiction’s protagonists, you may come across a special rift which will lead you to a “Side Story”—the game’s version of side quests or bonus levels. 
Read more...
articles.title: You Probably Missed This Awesome Side Story In Split Fiction

articles.author: Kenneth Shepard
articles.description:
We are two weeks away from the premiere of The Last of Us’ second season. The HBO live-action adaptation will be based on The Last of Us Part II, and anyone who’s played it knows it builds heavily off the first game’s ending. As such, showrunners Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann are doing promotional interviews for the…
Read more...
articles.title: The Last Of Us Creator Says Joel Was Right, And I Wish He Wouldn't

articles.author: Samuel Moreno
articles.description:
Monster Hunter Wilds offers up a lot of diverse weapon types to choose from, including the simple Great Sword, the transforming Charge Blade, and a giant music-based weapon known as the Hunting Horn. Two weapons that aren’t quite as distinct from each other are the similarly named Heavy Bowgun and Light Bowgun. What…
Read more...
articles.title: Let's Compare And Contrast Monster Hunter Wilds' Heavy And Light Bowguns

articles.author: Kenneth Shepard
articles.description:
Every time I think we’re done hearing about the Elon Musk fake gamer saga, a new bit of information comes out revealing that the Tesla and X owner who bought his way into an unelected government position is apparently bad at video games. Generally, I haven’t paid too much attention to the developing story of Musk…
Read more...
articles.title: Elon Musk’s Daughter Says He's Terrible At Overwatch

articles.author: Ethan Gach
articles.description:
This year marks the 25th anniversary of Final Fantasy IX and Square Enix has announced some celebration plans for the PS1-era RPG. The publisher said it’s “preparing various projects,” including new figures of the main heroes that slightly alter their appearance. It’s enough to have long-time fans once again believing …
Read more...
articles.title: Final Fantasy IX Remake Rumors Intensify Amid Anniversary Hype

articles.author: John Walker
articles.description:
I absolutely adore PowerWash Simulator. I’ve adored it for three years now. It’s the console game I keep coming back to; curling up on the couch, putting on a podcast, and cleaning the muck off an ice rink or UFO. It got me through a horrible bout of covid, it offers me comfort when I’m feeling down, and it keeps…
Read more...
articles.title: PowerWash Simulator Has Two Key Problems The Sequel Needs To Fix

articles.description:
Here's the estimated equivalent locally.
Nintendo hasn't officially revealed the local pricing for Switch 2 game upgrade packs yet but it seems the company's official Japanese website might have now given fans a rough idea of what it might cost to enjoy certain past-generation games with various enhancements on the new system.
According to the company's Japanese website, players who already own a game and want to upgrade it can expect to pay between 1,000 to 2,000 yen, which is estimated to equate to about "$10 to $15" (or the regional equivalent).
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Game Upgrade Pack Prices Seemingly Revealed (Japan)

articles.description:
What's going on here?

Nintendo's Switch 2 Direct highlighted all sorts of new and existing titles but one of the more interesting discoveries in the American broadcast was artwork for what appears to Yoshi's Woolly World (officially known as Poochy and Yoshi's Woolly World on the 3DS) in the "compatible Nintendo Switch titles".
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Oops, Yoshi's Woolly World Featured In Switch 2's "Compatible Switch Games"

articles.description:
Helping developers target the launch.
This isn't exactly a surprise, but it's been confirmed the game engine Unity will be providing developers with official support for Nintendo Switch 2.
Here's some PR about how this platform will be "made available soon" in Unity 6 for approved Switch 2 developers targeting the launch of the platform:
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Switch 2 Support To Be Made Available Soon In Unity Game Engine

articles.description:
Sonic and much more is on the way.

Nintendo overloaded fans during the Switch 2 Direct with all sorts of game announcements, and if you didn't catch it - Sega will actually be bringing five titles to the system during its "launch window".
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Sega Announces Five Titles For Switch 2 "Launch Window"

articles.description:
As seen in Arcade Archives 2 Ridge Racer.
Nintendo Switch 2 is sporting all sorts of modern technology and one other addition is variable refresh rate support.
This has been highlighted on Nintendo's official website alongside all the other upgrades for this new hardware. Nintendo has been nice enough to provide a description about what exactly this technology does:
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Includes Support For Variable Refresh Rate Technology

articles.description:
"Available while supplies last".
If you're considering the Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle, you might need to make a decision sooner rather than later.
While this new offer might seem like it's just a standard package, it seems it will actually be a limited-time deal. Yes, according to Nintendo, this bundle will actually be a "limited time production" through to Fall 2025 (at least in the US) and available "while supplies last".
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Switch 2 Mario Kart World Bundle Will Be A "Limited Time" Offer

articles.description:
Active Expansion Pack subscription required.
Nintendo has announced it will be releasing paid "Switch 2 Edition" upgrade packs for select Switch games.
It seems you won't actually have to fork out extra (for at least some games) if you already have access to the title and an active Switch Online + Expansion Pack membership. As highlighted by Nintendo, these packs will be "no additional cost" to access for subscribers:
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: PSA: Switch Online Includes Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack Access At "No Additional Cost"

articles.description:
Samus unlocked a new upgrade.
Well, Metroid Prime 4: Beyond has now been officially confirmed as a cross-generation title, falling under Nintendo's new and enhanced line for the Switch 2.
In case you missed it, the game will support two modes - Quality Mode and Performance Mode. As we've previously mentioned, it will run at 4K at 60fps with HDR or 1080p at 120fps with HDR in docked. And on handheld, the choice will be either 1080p at 60fps or 720p at 120fps.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Video: Metroid Prime 4 Side-By-Side Early Graphics Comparison (Switch 2 & Switch)

articles.description:
Bring it on!
As if today's Switch 2 Direct wasn't enough of an info dump, Nintendo has also published a series of Ask the Developer interviews, so we can get even more details on the upcoming console.
In Chapter 4 of the discussion with Kouichi Kawamoto, Takuhiro Dohta and Tetsuya Sasaki, the chat moves onto the sworded issue of the eShop — something we're all hoping will see a much-needed spruce up — and, specifically, the improvements that have been implemented on Switch 2.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Nintendo Devs Reveal Some Big eShop Improvements On Switch 2

articles.description:
Putting the 'meh' in 'homehscreen'.
One of the biggest criticisms against the Nintendo Switch is its home screen. There's nothing wrong with it, per se, but it does lack a certain pizazz that we had come to expect from Nintendo's consoles. The House of Mario didn't pull back the curtain on what creative design swings the Switch 2 takes, menu-wise, in today's Direct, but it has shared an image of it in a recently updated webpage. Sorry folks, it's still pretty bland.
At an initial glance, you would be forgiven for assuming that the Switch 2 menu is a carbon copy of its predecessor. As seen on the Switch 2 Edition Games page, the menu takes the same white background and grey icon colour scheme as Switch 1, with some small differences in the lower bar — notably, the inclusion of the GameChat 'C' button.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Uh Oh, Switch 2's Home Screen Looks Just As Bland As We Feared

articles.description:
What could've been...
Hopefully, you'll have gotten used to the name 'Nintendo Switch 2' by now. Given how much we now know about Nintendo's latest hardware, the firm's approach to its name actually makes a lot of sense.
According to an Ask the Developer interview with Kouichi Kawamoto, Takuhiro Dohta, and Tetsuya Sasaki, however, it very nearly had a different name altogether; one that many fans were sincerely hoping for in the run up to the official reveal earlier this year.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Switch 2 Was Very Nearly Called 'Super Nintendo Switch'

articles.description:
Mario Kart! Elden Ring! Donkey Kong?!
Well, we've gone from knowing next-to-no information to knowing a boatload of information in roughly one hour. Nintendo has fully lifted the lid on its upcoming hardware in the Switch 2 Direct and it was a packed one.
Below, you will find the full April 2025 Nintendo Switch 2 Direct video, followed by a breakdown of every announcement, game reveal and trailer. There's a lot to get through, so let's dive in...
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Guide: Nintendo Switch 2 Direct April 2025 - Every Announcement, Game Reveal & Trailer

articles.description:
It's so pretty.
Nintendo has officially announced the Switch 2, bringing an end to literal years of rumours and speculation. Naturally, the games are the true star of the show, but the hardware itself is a slight to behold. Nintendo has unveiled the console, an accompanying Pro Controller, a camera, and more.
Here, you can take a peek at the Switch 2 and its accessories in all their glory. Be sure to let us know with a comment what you’ll be picking up to go along with your console when it launches on 5th June 2025.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Gallery: Here's A Closer Look At The Switch 2 Console And Accessories

articles.description:
Pre-orders open 8th/9th April.
Following on from the Direct showcase, Nintendo has announced that Switch 2 pre-orders will go live on the 8th April in the UK and Europe, and 9th April in the US and Canada.
According to one "large US retailer" (and anyone with an ounce of common sense), pre-orders are expected to sell out fast, so if you're hoping to get a Switch 2 on launch day, you'll want to slam down your money sharpish.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Guide: Where To Pre-Order Nintendo Switch 2

articles.description:
Could it really be the "pinnacle of all controllers"?
Now that we know the Switch 2 is coming so soon, all sorts of details are inevitably dropping about add-ons and other components, with one of the juiciest of these, of course, being the brand new iteration of the wonderful Switch Pro Controller.
The brand new Switch Pro Controller adds a whole bunch of cool new features to the original design, so let's take a look at the ones we know about.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: The Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller - All New Features Revealed

articles.description:
Along with several other big Switch games.
Nintendo has confirmed that select Switch games will receive a free upgrade to improve playability and performance on the Switch 2. Some titles may also receive added functionality for GameShare.
Chief amongst these is Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, a release that was widely criticised for its dire frame rate and hilarious bugs when it launched. It's not known exactly what the upgrade will bring to the table, but we're expecting some basic improvements to the overall performance.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Pokémon Scarlet And Violet Is Getting A Free Performance Upgrade On Switch 2

articles.description:
The worst of both worlds?
We didn't spot this in the Switch 2 Direct (although, frankly, there was so much packed in there we might have missed it), but Nintendo's website has a small section and an FAQ live detailing a new purchase option for "some physical games" on Switch 2.
They're called Game-Key Cards, but don't get too excited. From what we can gather, they're essentially codes-in-a-box, although it seems that Nintendo has managed to make even those a little bit worse for lovers of physical games.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Nintendo's Switch 2 'Game-Key Cards' Somehow Manage To Make Codes-In-A-Box Worse

articles.description:
Your complete guide to Switch 2 - release date, price, hardware, games.
The Switch 2 is the next console from Nintendo and is a direct successor to the original Nintendo Switch that launched all the way back in March 2017.
The company has announced a Switch 2 release date — it will launch worldwide on 5th June 2025. Nintendo also confirmed the price: Switch 2 will retail for $449.99 / £395.99 / €469,99, with pre-orders going live on 8th (UK/Europe) and 9th April (US/Canada), although they have been popping up sporadically at some retailers.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Guide: Nintendo Switch 2 Guide: Ultimate Resource

articles.description:
Just look at all those characters!
After giving us a full trailer in today's Switch 2 Direct, Nintendo has now revealed the box art for Mario Kart World, and it's pretty darn delightful.
The focus of this one is the racers. Mario takes centre stage, with a host of familiar faces spilling out behind him. Looking closely, it seems there will be a bunch of new characters hitting the track in this one, with a Goomba, Pokey, Biddybud, Mole and Penguin all spotted in their own karts on the cover.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Mario Kart World's Switch 2 Box Art Is Packed With Delightful Details

articles.description:
You'd better sit down for this...
It's official, the Nintendo Switch 2 is launching on 5th June 2025 at a retail price of $449.99 / €469.99 / £395.99. But how much do the actual games cost? Well, it's a bit complicated.
Not really, but it ain't simple. As reported by VGC, Mario Kart World will cost $80 / £75 physically, but will actually be cheaper if you opt for a digital copy. We don't have the US price at the time of writing, but a digital copy in the UK will set you back £66.99.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Switch 2 Games Cost A Bit More Than You're Probably Expecting

articles.description:
Mech my day.
Marvelous has shown off more footage of Titanic Scion, a new entry in the Daemon X Machina series, during today's Nintendo Direct.
Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion sees players taking to battle in their customisable 'Arsenal' mech and engaging in "fast-paced combat" as they "freely explore a deadly and dangerous open world on land or in the air."
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion Arrives On Nintendo Switch 2 This September

articles.description:
The Thick Red Line.
Nintendo has given us our first official look at what the Switch 2 physical game cases will look like with a peek at the Donkey Kong Bananza box art. We've got to admit, it's a beauty.
The art shows our HD hero, DK, pounding into the ground, sending cracks of colourful light up around him and his purple rocky pal. It's yet another look at the brand-new Donkey Kong design that we first caught wind of in the Switch 2 reveal trailer back in January — how about those emotive eyebrows, eh?
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Check Out Donkey Kong Bananza's Beautiful Switch 2 Box Art

articles.description:
Chronos-triggered!
Supergiant Games dropped the Early Access version of Hades 2 back in October of 2024 on PC - we've been playing a whole bunch of it on that platform - and are thusly well-placed to inform you to get it on your radars!
Yep, amidst all the very exciting announcements during Nintendo's Switch 2 Direct, we were positively ecstatic to see Hades 2 pop up, as we reckon to could be a killer action game for on-the-go situations. Have we told you how many hundreds of hours we've played of the first?
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Hades 2 Is Hacking & Slashing Its Way To Switch 2

articles.description:
Headfirst into the dungeon.
Enter the Gungeon is one of our favourite indie games of the past few years, and so we are popping off with excitement at the news that Enter the Gungeon 2 not only exists, but it's launching on Nintendo Switch 2!
As part of the latest Nintendo Direct, we got a brand new reveal trailer for the latest from Dodge Roll Games, which you can check out above, and lo-and-behold they've really went with a big old switch on the art style.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Enter The Gungeon 2 Announced For Switch 2 And It's Got Some New Twists!

articles.description:
Priced 49,980 yen, which is around $333 USD.
After the Switch 2 Direct wrapped up, Nintendo put out a press release announcing its pricing in different regions, including Japan. However, it appears that Japanese gamers will have an extra, cheaper option if they're happy to have a Japanese-language-only Switch 2.
"The Japanese-Language System" is priced at 49,980 yen (approximately $333.87 USD at the time of writing), versus 69,980 yen ($467.48 USD) for the Multi-Language equivalent, which will only be available from the Japanese My Nintendo Store. The base system will retail for $449.99 in the US.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Nintendo Is (Kinda) Returning To Region-Locking With A Cheaper Japanese Switch 2

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Ondřej Surý)
articles.description: V počítačovém světě se dočasná data ukládají do keše pro hladký chod programů. Webové prohlížeče a CDN využívají kešování pro rychlejší přístup, ale omezená paměť vyžaduje efektivní cache-eviction algoritmy.
articles.title: SIEVE: algoritmus pro kešování lepší než LRU?

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Na praktických příkladech si ukážeme zpracování a deserializace dat vrácených MCP serverem, zjistíme, zda dokáže server obsloužit více klientů souběžně a na závěr si popíšeme posílání rastrových dat serverem klientovi.
articles.title: Model Context Protocol: vznikající standard pro potřeby aplikací využívajících AI a LLM (2.část)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Na konferenci Peering Days, která se konala 25. a 27. března v chorvatském Splitu, se odborníci z oblasti počítačových sítí sešli, aby hovořili o odolnosti internetových sítí, telemetrii a novinkách v NetBoxu.
articles.title: Musíme budovat odolné sítě pro svět plný hrozeb a AI, Peering Days 2025

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jiří Sluka)
articles.description: Pravidelná sonda do světa software. Podíváme se na nástroj pro real-time sledování logovacích souborů, budeme pracovat s titulky a nakonec vyzkoušíme řešení pro monitoring síťového provozu.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (2. 4. 2025): sledujte logy a síťový provoz

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Současně s vývojem aplikací, které do nějaké míry využívají umělou inteligenci a/nebo velké jazykové modely se ukázala potřeba existence standardního mechanismu pro komunikaci mezi jednotlivými moduly těchto aplikací.
articles.title: Model Context Protocol: vznikající standard pro aplikace AI a LLM

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Společnost EA otevřela zdrojové kódy pro hry Command & Conquer, Red Alert, Command & Conquer Renegade a Command & Conquer Generals. Nejnovější vydání TR2X, open source reimplementace hry Tomb Raider II, přináší podporu Linuxu.
articles.title: EA otevřela tři hry, TR2X s podporou Linuxu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: CSIRT.CZ)
articles.description: V aktuálním dílu Postřehů se podíváme na operaci Interpolu nazvanou Red Card, na zranitelnosti v Kubernetes, v Google Chrome pro Windows nebo chytrých televizorech. Podíváme se také na nové nástroje a praktiky útočníků.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: operace Red Card vyústila v zatčení tří set lidí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Správce balíčků Zypper v systému openSUSE představil experimentální podporu paralelního stahování a přepracovaný backend médií. Společnost Canonical představila beta verzi připravovaného Ubuntu 25.04 (Plucky Puffin).
articles.title: Zypper zrychluje díky paralelnímu stahování, Ubuntu 25.04 má betaverzi

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Hry přes Wayland na GNOME i KDE v Ubuntu 25.04 lepší než s X11, Lip-Bu Tan (Intel) versus velké grafické karty, týden v GNOME nejen o načítání obrázků, podsvícení pro iPhony a iPady v jádru 6.15.
articles.title: Lepší podpora pro iPhony a iPady v Linuxu, KDE s nulovým počtem kritických chyb

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Víte, co je lepší než nový procesor? Nové znalosti! A víte, co je ještě lepší než nové znalosti? Nové znalosti, které vám zaplatí Úřad práce formou dotací. Naučíte se něco užitečného s podporou EU.
articles.title: Dotace na IT kurzy: nechte EU zaplatit za vaše vzdělání a ušetřete rodinný rozpočet

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Aktuálně má Intel na trhu druhou/„třetí“ generaci velkých grafických karet známou jako Battlemage (jak to s ní bude dál, je krajně nejisté). Před ní udělal velký krok do světa grafických karet pro hráče s generací Alchemist, známou též jako DG2. A před ní bylo možné pokoutními cestami sehnat kartu generace první, tedy DG1. Běžně ale v prodeji nebyla a nikdo soudný, kdo vyžaduje takové „pošetilé věci“ jako podporu herních enginů a stabilitu ovladačů za všech okolností by si ji beztak nekoupil a ostatně se dlouho na trhu neohřála.
articles.title: Intel DG1, první generace velkých grafik před Alchemist už bez experimentální podpory

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Krátce po Firefoxu 137 vychází též nová verze prohlížeče Chrome 135 (resp. Chromium a dalších webových prohlížečů na Chromiu stavějících). V rámci rozšiřování podporovaných CSS vlastností došlo například na pseudo elementy ::column, ::scroll-button(), ::scroll-marker a ::scroll-marker-group, vlastnosti overflow-inline a overflow-block, funkci shape() či stylování vnořených CSS elementů.
articles.title: Chrome 135 s řadou novinek pro API i podporu CSS

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Prometheus je moderní monitoringový nástroj a metrics server. Umožňuje sbírat metrická data z vaší aplikace a většiny komponent vaší infrastruktury a nad těmito daty dělat grafy (v Grafaně) a vytvářet varování. Prometheus spadá pod CNCF, stejně jako Kubernetes. Pokud chcete podrobně sledovat stav infrastruktury a služeb, zúčastněte se našeho dvoudenního školení Prometheus.
articles.title: Prometheus: moderní monitoringový nástroj a sběrač metrik (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Fedora Engineering and Steering Committee (FESCo) schválila balík nápadů, které se objeví v rámci přespříštího vydání linuxové distribuce Fedora 43. Například vedle Apache Maven 3 bude k dispozici i jako paralelně instalovaná alternativa novější verze Maven 4, kdy v tomto projektu právě finišují práce na vydání verze 4.0.0.
articles.title: Schváleno pro Fedoru 43: nová verze RPM 6.0 či wallpapery v JPEG-XL

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Vilém Sládek)
articles.description: Aplikace Datovka od sdružení CZ.NIC (verze 4.26.0) má nově upravený dialog pro přiřazování tagů, které se nově přiřazují zaškrtnutím v seznamu. V nastavení Datovky je také možné zvolit škálování fontu, pokud někomu nevyhovuje standardní velikost a chce zvětšit písmo. Úpravy se dotkly i volitelné šablony vzhledu, aby se lépe integrovala do světlého/tmavého systémového režimu. Přibyl také nástroj pro záchranu datových zpráv z poškozené databáze.
articles.title: Datovka 4.26.0 umožňuje měnit šablony vzhledu aplikace

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Nejen velké kompozitory, ale nyní též i základní knihovna wlroots implementuje podporu Wayland protokolu color-management-v1. To všem projektům na ní stavějícím – například Wayfire, Labwc, Cage – dává možnost využívat na Waylandu správu barev a HDR. Projekt wlroots tak srovnává krok s velkými desktopy jako KDE a GNOME, které ve svých výchozích kompozitorech příslušný protokol již nasazují.
articles.title: Wayland knihovna wlroots dostává správu barev a HDR

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Uživatelé připojující na Linuxu exFAT oddíly s volbou discard se mohou těšit na obrovské zrychlení operace mazání souborů. Yuezhang Mo ze společnosti Sony připravil patch, který podporu dávkového mazání použitím discard implementuje a přináší tomu odpovídající nárůst výkonu.
articles.title: Patch pro exFAT v jádru Linux 6.15: místo 5 minut smazáno za 2 sekundy

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Mozilla vydala novou verzi Firefoxu. S pořadovým číslem 137 (prozatím vycházíme z popisu novinek beta verze, finální ještě nebyly zveřejněny) přináší schopnost identifikovat všechny odkazy v PDF a převést je na hypertextové odkazy, plus pro Linux možnost využívat hardwarovou akceleraci přehrávání obsahu ve formátu HEVC / H.265. PDF soubory lze navíc podepsat
articles.title: Firefox 137 přináší akceleraci HEVC na Linuxu a vylepšenou podporou PDF

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Fakulta informačních technologií ČVUT v Praze (FIT ČVUT) otevírá nový magisterský studijní program Kvantová informatika. Program bude probíhat ve spolupráci s dalšími třemi fakultami ČVUT – Fakultou jadernou a fyzikálně inženýrskou, Fakultou elektrotechnickou a Fakultou strojní. Tento program vzniká v reakci na rychle rostoucí význam kvantové informatiky a cílí na přípravu studentů pro profesní dráhu v oblasti kvantových výpočtů, algoritmů a bezpečnostních technologií, uvádí v oznámení fakulta.
articles.title: FIT ČVUT otevírá magisterský studijní program Kvantová informatika

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Tretí ročník Bratislava OpenCamp sa uskutoční už túto sobotu na FIIT STU. Registrácia účastníkov prebieha online a účasť je bezplatná.
articles.title: Bratislava OpenCamp už túto sobotu prinesie témy ako bezpečnosť, zálohy či pohľad do štátneho IT

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Majitelé notebooků s procesory Intel Core Ultra mohou použít Intel Low Power Mode Daemon (ILPMD), který podle zátěže zapíná a vypíná P a E jádra a další věci, čímž šetří energii.
articles.title: Intel Low Power Mode Daemon pro Linux

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Ubuntu před nějakou dobou zkoušelo kompilovat všechny balíčky s optimalizací -O3 . V pátek pak vývojáři Ubuntu rozhodli, že optimalizovat všechny balíčky s -O3  nemá cenu. Velikost všech deb balíčků vzrostla o 6 % a velikost obrazů ISO o 4 %.
articles.title: Ubuntu nebude kompilovat všechny balíčky s -O3

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Marek Pšenka)
articles.description: Jaký je embedded vývoj v Rustu? Přijďte si poslechnout reálné zkušenosti. V úterý 8. dubna se koná třetí setkání uživatelské skupiny Rust Moravia. Martin Slováček a Karel Gardaš z Edhouse se podělí o své zkušenosti s využitím embedded Rustu pro řízení výroby vodíku.
articles.title: Embedded Rust meetup 8. dubna v Olomouci

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Aleš)
articles.description: Mobilní operátor T-Mobile oznámil spuštění podpory IPv6 ve své mobilní síti. Informaci zveřejnil na síti X (dříve Twitter), kde uvedl, že IPv6 je nyní dostupné pro většinu zákazníků a bude se dále rozšiřovat.
articles.title: T-Mobile ČR spustil IPv6 ve své mobilní síti

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Vilém Sládek)
articles.description: Organizátoři Dne IPv6, tradiční akce věnované tématům spojeným s tímto protokolem, vyhlásili call for presentations. Na webu konference mohou zájemci přihlašovat příspěvky o délce 20 nebo 40 minut či 10minutové lighting talky a to až do 18. dubna. Tvůrci programu uvítají návrhy přednášek z akademického i komerčního sektoru, které mohou být technického i netechnického zaměření.
articles.title: Den IPv6 proběhne 6. června, organizátoři vyhlásili call for presentations

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Provozujete vlastní infrastrukturu a chcete vědět, v jakém stavu se v každém okamžiku nachází? Zabbix vám umožní monitorovat infrastrukturu z pohledu sítí, tak i z pohledu operačních systémů až po aplikace. Přináší ucelené monitorovací řešení. Naučíme vás konfigurovat monitorovací systém Zabbix od základních kroků až po složité nízkoúrovňové objevování monitorovaných objektů.
articles.title: Zabbix: monitorujte svou infrastrukturu a mějte ji pod kontrolou (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Windows 11 při instalaci požaduje vytvoření účtu Microsoft. Dříve bylo možné použít skript bypassnro.cmd, který vytvoření účtu Microsoft přeskočil a byl použit jen lokální účet. V preview verzi 26200.5516 pro insiders, která vyšla v pátek, je však tento skript odstraněn. Microsoft říká:
articles.title: Windows 11 zakáže bypassnro.cmd, který slouží k použití lokálního účtu při instalaci

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: LRA)
articles.description: Na jednání vlády 26. března 2025 padlo rozhodnutí o způsobu realizace klientské části Evropské peněženky digitální identity (EUDIW). Na základě předloženého materiálu vláda rozhodla, že jako obchodní model pro realizaci zvolí koncesi. Koncesionář bude vybrán podle zákona o veřejných zakázkách. Vláda tak chce část nákladů na vytvoření a provoz klientské části systému EUDIW pokrýt obchodní činností vybraného koncesionáře a doufá, že tak ušetří peníze z rozpočtu.
articles.title: Evropskou peněženku pro Česko vybuduje komerční subjekt s koncesí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Přesně podle původního plánu bylo oznámeno zmrazení připravovaného Debianu 13 Trixie. Vývojáři už přestali přijímat žádosti o zařazení nových balíků do vydání. Správci vývojářských balíčků používaných pro sestavení softwaru (kompilátory, linkery, knihovny a podobně) by neměli provádět žádné změny bez předchozího souhlasu týmu zodpovědného za vydání.
articles.title: Vývojáři zmrazili Debian 13 Trixie, nepřijímají nové balíčky

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Daniel Stenberg na svém blogu oznámil setkání curl up 2025, které proběhne o prvním květnovém víkendu v Praze.Je to naše každoroční akce a fyzické setkání. Je to neformální akce, které se obvykle účastní dvacet až třicet lidí, píše autor projektu. Sedíme v místnosti a mluvíme o tématech souvisejících s projektem curl. Sdílíme zkušenosti, znalosti, nápady a postřehy.
articles.title: Setkání příznivců projektu cURL proběhne v květnu v Praze

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Prohlížeč Vivaldi bude mít integrovanou podporu pro Proton VPN bez nutnosti instalovat doplněk.  Proton VPN má pomoci uživatelům Vivaldi omezit sledování velkými společnostmi.
articles.title: Vivaldi integruje podporu pro Proton VPN

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Po 16 letech Google mění způsob vývoje svého mobilního operačního systému Android. Nadále bude Android vyvíjen v privátním repozitáři. Ten bude dostupný  pouze firmám s licencí GMS (Google Mobile Services) jako je Samsung nebo Motorola. Důvodem přechodu na privátní vývoj je zjednodušení procesu.
articles.title: Google bude vyvíjet Android privátně

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Amazon vypustil nový firmware 5.18.1 pro svoje čtečky e-knih Kindle od 10. generace (2018). Pokud máte nový Kindle Paperwhite 12. generace (2024) nebo Colorsoft 1. generace (2024) tato aktualizace umožní zapnout senzor v těle čtečky.
articles.title: Nový Kindle umí otáčet stránky po poklepání na bok či zadní stranu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Ve středu bylo do databáze PostgreSQL přidána možnost použít IO_uring pro rychlé asynchronní IO. Je potřeba překládat s přepínačem --with-liburing a k tomu v konfiguraci nastavit io_method=io_uring.
articles.title: PostgreSQL 18 bude výrazně rychlejší s IO_uring

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Včera chvíli před půlnocí počet domén s koncovkou .cz překonal hranici 1,5 milión. Aktuálně je to asi o 450 méně, protože některé domény byly zrušeny, ale jedná se o další rekord.
articles.title: Počet domén .cz překonal 1,5 miliónu

articles.author: Reklama
articles.description: Bláznivé ceny v bláznivém měsíci plném změn počasí, které se v dubnu mění každou chvíli. Bláznivě nízké jsou teď ceny i na Goodoffer24.com, tak kupte klíč k doživotní licenci Windows 11 CDkey a Office.

Table of Contents

Why you should choose this loadout?



The best HDR loadout to use in Black Ops 6


Screenshot by Destructoid


Here are the best attachments to use in Black Ops 6 for the HDR:



Barrel: Gain-Twist Barrel


Rear Grip: Quickdraw Grip


Stock: Heavy Stock


Laser: Strelok Laser


Fire Mods: Rapid Fire



The HDR is an anti-material bolt action sniper rifle that excels in long range combat, thanks to its 12.7x108mm ammo. Combine all the attachments above and it will be a force to be reckoned in multiplayer.


Why you should choose this loadout?


The Gain-Twist Barrel greatly improves the bullet velocity of the sniper, which comes in handy during medium to long-range gunfights.


You can shoot down enemies quicker if you equip the Quickdraw Grip, as this rear grip greatly increases the ADS speed of the sniper and also while jumping. But the Quickdraw Grip increases Flinch Resistance, and this is where the Heavy Stock shines by improving it.


Equip the Strelok Laser to tighten the spread and increase accuracy when the aiming transitions between hipfire and ADS. However, enemies can see a blue beam all the time. Rapid Fire will significantly improve Rechamber speed and slightly improve fire rate. Bullet velocity, horizontal and vertical recoil control take a slight hit in exchange.

Activision has confirmed there's an issue with the Kilo 141 that's preventing it from being added to loadouts in Black Ops 6 or Warzone, which is currently offline for 24 hours ahead of Verdansk's return tomorrow.




The returning gun, which is free for all players to grab now as season three has launched in BO6 while Warzone preps for tomorrow, was a hugely popular weapon in Warzone's early days and has been highly anticipated by players, so this current bug is quite annoying.


Thankfully, the issue is being worked on by Treyarch and Activision who are aware of the issue, but it's still a pain in the back for players looking to use the weapon and level it up ahead of Warzone tomorrow, or to use it on the new BO6 Zombies map, Shattered Veil.


Double XP and double weapon XP is currently live in BO6, so the weapon leveling process should go quickly once it's available. But for now, players will have to use other new guns like the CR-56 AMAX or HDR in lieu of the Kilo for the time being.


Some players are reporting a workaround to get to use the Kilo 141, though. If you enter Warzone, then equip a Kilo 141 in your loadout, equip an optic scope, back out of Warzone, return to BO6 MP, and then you should be able to add the Kilo to a loadout.


It appears that CoD is also having issues on Xbox itself at the time of writing, meaning a wide array of gamers are probably frustrated by what's going on with the new season's launch on top of not being able to play Warzone at all until tomorrow.


Update on April 2 at 1:38pm CT: Activision says the issue has been fixed.


"Players will need to relaunch Call of Duty and enter the Call of Duty: Warzone tile again to obtain access to the Kilo 141 in custom loadouts."

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: UN Database WIPO ALERT Helps to Facilitate Globalized Pirate Site Blocking

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In a closely watched battle between music publishers and AI developer Anthropic, a California court has denied a request to halt the use of copyrighted song lyrics with its refusal to grant a preliminary injunction. The court ruled that the music publisher failed to demonstrate immediate and irreparable harm, while the scope of the requested restrictions was "ever-expanding". In addition, Anthropic's motion to dismiss several of the music companies' claims was granted,
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anthropic Scores Preliminary Victory in AI-Copyright Clash Against Music Companies (Updated)

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A lawsuit filed by several authors against Meta centers on Meta's alleged use of pirated books for AI training data and the technical details of BitTorrent which was used to obtain them. Yesterday, Meta filed a motion for summary judgment, while countering the authors' request to resolve the copyright claims in their favor. Meta's request includes new information, including the revelation that its uploads of 'pirate' library data were roughly 30% of the data it downloaded. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Meta’s BitTorrent Uploads of ‘Pirate Library’ Data Equaled 30% of Downloads, Expert Says

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Premier League, Sky & ACE are celebrating the sentencing of one of the most elusive targets ever pursued in the pirate IPTV market. The man operated an IPTV empire out of Lebanon, supplying pirated content 'wholesale' all around world. Yet, despite an investigation that may already be close to a decade old, the man still isn't being named, and his platform isn't being named either. At least not officially.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Premier League, Sky & ACE Celebrate Elusive Globe IPTV Prison Sentence

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Danish authorities have claimed two new victories in the ongoing battle against online piracy. A 46-year-old man, who allegedly uploaded content to the Danish torrent trackers "SuperBits" and "DanishBytes", was sentenced to nine months in prison. The other defendant, a 48-year-old man, was linked to 'The Scene'. He received a twelve-month sentence for hosting two servers and sharing pirated content in one of the most elusive piracy groups.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Torrent Site Uploader and Member of ‘The Scene’ Sentenced to Prison in Denmark

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Two senators have presented a bill to address what is now openly described as a crisis in French football. The draft envisions sweeping reform to tackle "structural" issues, including broadcasting rights and the ever-present threat from illegal streaming services. On the table, seven years in prison and a €750,000 fine for pirate IPTV suppliers operating as a group, three years and €300,000 for those not, and a new crime of inciting use of pirate IPTV services or software.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: France Mulls Instant IPTV Blocks, €750K Fines & New Piracy Crime of ‘Incitement’

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In an unexpected turn of events, the director of the Pirate Bay documentary TPB-AFK has sent takedown notices to YouTube requesting its removal. The director states that he sees the streaming portal as a radicalizing platform full of hate. The takedowns are not without controversy, however, as TPB-AFK was published under a Creative Commons license. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Director Uses Takedowns to Remove Pirate Bay Docu “TPB-AFK” from YouTube

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Strike 3 Holdings continues its quest against alleged BitTorrent pirates in U.S. courts. This week the adult entertainment company secured sizable default judgments in three copyright infringement cases. The defendants, none of which appeared at a federal court in Georgia, were ordered to pay significant monetary damages, up to $97,500 each.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Court Orders Up to $97,500 in Damages for Sharing ‘Adult’ Films via BitTorrent

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Last December the Court of Milan ordered Cloudflare to block sites added to Italy's Piracy Shield system. Cloudflare sees itself as a neutral intermediary but increasingly frustrated rightsholders say it should play a more active role by assisting their fight against piracy. A decision issued by the same court now requires Google to poison its Public DNS to prevent access to pirate sites. It was handed down on March 11 without Google being heard in the matter.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Court Orders Google to Poison Public DNS to Prevent IPTV Piracy

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A criminal case believed to be the largest of its type ever launched in Greece went to trial last week. A total of 17 defendants stand accused of participating in a criminal organization that sold pirate IPTV subscriptions and benefited to the tune of 25 million euros. Under new law, members of the public who buy illegal IPTV packages face 700 euro fines. Today we take a look at how those people will get caught and what happens when they do.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: New Pirate IPTV Law: How Subscribers Will Inform Authorities Who to Fine €750

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (mduggan)
articles.description:
We are excited to announce the classic Dynamix adventure games The Adventures of Willy Beamish and Heart of China are now ready for testing in ScummVM!
As the titular Willy Beamish, you play a 9-year-old troublemaker from Frumpton, USA. All you want to do is play Nintari and hang out with your friends, but your parents keep giving you so many chores... and even when you get them done, larger and more sinister forces are at work in your small town. A kid can't get a break!
In Heart of China, you start as retired WWI pilot Jake "Lucky" Masters. After a run-in with Hong Kong businessman E.A. Lomax, you feel driven by a strong sense of duty (and your massive debts!) to help him track down his kidnapped daughter. Work your way through a branching plot and the opportunity to play as three different characters to solve the puzzles and get Kate home.
Along with the previously announced Rise of the Dragon, these games complete Dynamix's short series of adventure games using the DGDS engine.
To test these games, you’ll need a DOS version of the game (both are available from GOG) and a daily development build. Be sure to check the notes on the wiki for each game, and please report any bugs on our issue tracker.
>
articles.title: The Dynamix duo of Willy Beamish and Heart of China are ready for testing

Ať si o jeho skladatelských kvalitách myslíte cokoliv, Hans Zimmer je dnes pravděpodobně nejslavnějším a nejlépe placeným skladatelem filmové hudby. A je jedním z hybatelů změny filmové hudby jako takové, od symfonických kompozic minulých desetiletí k elektronické / rockové jednoduchosti současnosti. Více jsem o této změně vyplodil zde a jsem na to pyšný.
Ale zpět k Zimmerovi.
Tento film (který bude uveden 19.3. v našich kinech, ale ne v mnoha) je záznamem jeho nedávného koncertu v Dubaji, ale jde o mnohem víc, než jen o záznam koncertu.
Především, Zimmerovy koncerty vždycky byly velká podívaná a ani v tomto případě tomu není jinak.

Znamená to mimo jiné, že všichni hudebníci mají pečlivě sladěné oblečení a líčení, v sále je spousta reflektorů, laserů, video mappingu a všeho možného. Navíc…
